protocol.scope:
Deterministic post-answer guards on completed real Qwen calls.

This is a retrospective baseline evaluation on known cases, not new Qwen
inference, an independent confirmation set, or a trained novel method.
protocol.primary: Timestamp errors and answered timestamp count, with captured-only as the essential baseline.
protocol.success_for_guard_utility: Fewer errors than restored-only without fewer answered timestamps.
protocol.not_sufficient_for_method_research: Matching captured-only is not incremental task benefit or novelty.
protocol.independence: Same known five tracks, two repeats; no held-out validation, no new API calls, no tuned thresholds.
protocol.audio_claim: Check actual restorer interface and runtime calls; do not mistake downstream audio fusion for audio-conditioned pixel generation.

mechanism_audit.finding: FastDVDnet has no audio input; this pipeline cannot test audio-created visual hallucinations.
mechanism_audit.interpretation: Audio is used later by TalkNet. That is audiovisual inference, not audio-conditioned restoration.

checks: Hashes, label arrays, uniform base configuration, guard unit checks and actual restorer call signatures verified.
limitations: Known cases; no independent validation; two repeats are not two videos; no novelty claim; post-answer gating, not fresh Qwen reasoning.
